name: Bhoonidhi Open Data Access Gateway
description: Official ISRO/NRSC Earth observation data catalogue and download API using STAC.

name: Bhuvan Indian Geo-Platform
coverage: India Administrative Boundaries (National to Village), Land Use Land Cover (LULC), Geomorphology, Disaster Portals
description: ISRO national geoportal for multi-scale Indian administrative hierarchies, cadastral boundaries, and thematic natural resource cartography.

name: IMD National Weather Forecasting Centre & Hydromet Division
organization: India Meteorological Department, Ministry of Earth Sciences
description: Official meteorological gauge measurements, standard precipitation normal departure statistics, and meteorological alerts across all Indian districts.

name: NASA Fire Information for Resource Management System (FIRMS)
organization: NASA Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS) Project
coverage: South Asia / India VIIRS 375m & MODIS 1km Active Fire / Thermal Anomalies
description: Satellite thermal anomaly detection delivering active agricultural stubble and forest wildfire coordinates.

name: Disaster Management Support Programme (DMSP)
license: National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) & ISRO Shared Directive
coverage: Major Indian River Basins (Brahmaputra, Ganga, Mahanadi, Godavari, Kosi) & Flood Inundation Layers
description: Operational flood inundation mapping, cyclone tracking, and landslide hazard spatial layers generated from microwave (RISAT/EOS-04) and optical satellites.
